intervals.note: Installation window from home.cern's FASER page, which gives only the LS2 date range (2019-2021), not an exact installation date.
intervals.quote: was installed during the second long shutdown of CERN’s accelerator complex (2019-2021)

end.note: Ends at the LHC-wide start of Long Shutdown 3 (June 2026); mirrors experiment:faser.

intervals.label: operating
intervals.quote: It started taking data at the beginning of Run 3 of the LHC in July 2022.

end.note: CERN schedule: the LHC resumes operation in mid-2030; the rest of the CERN complex restarts in stages from mid-2028.

intervals.label: Long Shutdown 3
intervals.locator: home.cern/science/long-shutdown-3, item of 5 August 2026 "The LHC is being warmed up from near absolute zero to room temperature"
intervals.note: The detector record carries the same Long Shutdown 3 interval as experiment:faser, whose interval note gives the evidence and CERN's wording for the bounds; the state is inferred from the LHC being shut down.
intervals.quote: Following its final physics run, the accelerator has been switched off to begin CERN’s Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) ... The HiLumi LHC, scheduled to begin operation in 2030

name: FASER detector
notes: No dimension/mass specs were sourced; left out rather than guessed.

placements.quote: FASER will be located 480 m downstream of the ATLAS IP in the unused service tunnel TI12

summary.plain: A compact particle detector in a disused CERN tunnel, combining a tracking spectrometer with a special emulsion-and-tungsten neutrino detector called FASERv.
summary.technical: Forward spectrometer plus FASERv (emulsion film / tungsten target-detector) subdetector, installed in TI12 during LS2 (2019-2021), operating since LHC Run 3 (July 2022).

technology.locator: FASER detector paper (arXiv:2207.11427), Sec. 1 (magnet system; emulsion detector); home.cern FASER page (FASERv)
technology.quote: The detector includes three 0.57 T dipole magnets, one surrounding the decay volume and the other two embedded in the tracking spectrometer. ... The tungsten acts as the target for the neutrino to interact with, and the emulsion films record the trajectories of charged particles
technology.value: forward spectrometer with a tracking/magnet system and the FASERv emulsion-tungsten neutrino subdetector
